query_text: Which Formula Student cost rule requires all costs to be displayed in EUR and exchange rates to be documented for non-EUR currencies?
reason: S_3.5.12 directly addresses EUR currency display and exchange-rate documentation.

query_text: Which rule requires each assembly constituent part to be classified as bought or made?
Which rule says that only metric units may be used in the BOM?
Which rule says only parts available from a catalog may be designated as bought parts?
reason: S_3.5.10 directly addresses catalog availability for bought parts.

query_text: Which interpretive rule concerns making cost calculations as realistic as possible and excluding R&D or real estate capital expenditure?
reason: S_3.5.11 is the interpretive FSG realistic-cost rule. DERIVED_QG_001 is not a substitute.

query_text: Which rule says a self-manufactured fastener is considered a part?
reason: S_3.4.6 directly covers self-manufactured fastener classification.

query_text: Which internal quality gate checks that cost-bearing material process and fastener records have traceable source IDs?
reason: DERIVED_QG_001 is the internal traceability quality gate and is not an FSG rule.
